$comment: site shape: { name, home, logo: { light, dark? } (media ids), logoHeight, labels: { navigation, submenu, menu, closeMenu, phone?, theme? }, header: { menu: [{ label, href?, children?: [{ label, href }] }], phone: { text, tel }, cta: { label, href }, sticky }, themeToggle }. An item with children and no href draws its label as the span form. The theme toggle is offered (site.themeToggle true) and named (labels.theme). The markup's note says the server render is a span.salt-theme-toggle[aria-hidden] placeholder until script mounts it, but the theme-toggle role lists button only (the checker refuses the span), so the button form is drawn: aria-pressed false, the sun and moon icons.
summary: A wordmark header with a flat menu and the theme toggle offered and named, drawn in its button form.
